integrity: The two- and four-period formulas are exact for every indexed cyclic ring of length at least three. Independent external validation has not been undertaken.
scientific_limitations: Only least temporal periods 1, 2, and 4 are classified. The full recurrent dynamics, other periods and basins are not determined. Historical priority is not certified. The proof relies on a finite, exact, replayable space-time component certificate rather than formal proof-assistant verification.
title: A sharp forty-nine-site gap and two entropy scales in Rule 126 periodic dynamics
